BL-718 — DEFECT — Bubble talk mirror drops long replies and fails silently
What it solves: Severity rationale: the human loses a durable transcript, not control of the
swarm — the spoken turn itself still works and Cursor Remote still shows the
text. Contained, so medium; deliberately not high, which would put it in the
Article 3.2.4 expedite lane the human ruled out.
Approval context: Two defaults chosen without asking, cheap to amend: (1) a mirror failure is surfaced to the OPERATOR channel (log plus operator alert), not spoken to the human on the phone — the turn itself succeeded and interrupting it with a delivery complaint seemed worse than a quiet operator alert; (2) the mi…
BL-718 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-718" (or "reject BL-718 <reason>") to act.
